name: @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin
description: DSH: Windows2MacOS — drive the same project on online Windows and macOS machines from one DeepSeek account, across networks and regions (Tailscale, public VPS with TLS, or a tunnel). Rabbit relay + per-machine Localside + eight DSH tools (replicate / split), with nine aggregate verdicts and signed requests.
